Chapter 7

RVV 1990 Traffic Sign Catalogue

A clear visual reference to the traffic signs in Appendix 1 of the Dutch RVV 1990, checked against the 2026 sign catalogue.

  • A — Speed
  • B — Priority
  • C — Road closures / access restrictions
  • D — Direction
  • E — Parking and stopping
  • F — Other obligations and prohibitions
  • G — Traffic rules / road types
  • H — Built-up area
  • J — Warning
  • K — Direction signs
  • L — Information
How to use this catalogue

The sign codes and meanings below follow Appendix 1 of the RVV 1990. The English wording is a concise translation of the current Dutch legal description. A supplementary plate can narrow or qualify how a sign applies in a particular location.

The official appendix uses a single code, L3, for a bus/tram stop. This page keeps three graphical L3 variants because the image library contains three separate SVG files; they are variants of the same legal sign code, not three separate RVV sign numbers.
